scope: Compact biographical entry for jefferson in its cryptographic sense: the cylinder device the retained handbook describes, its significance and its limits.

coverageRationale.zh: 紧凑解释杰斐逊转筒在多表密码机器叙述中的位置；不扩展到其政治生涯或其他领域贡献。
coverageRationale.en: A compact account of the Jefferson cylinder in the narrative of polyalphabetic cipher machines; it does not extend to his political career or other contributions.

entries.relatedPolicy: Related entries are distinct concepts or people; no merge or replacement is implied.

zh.principle: **人物**：托马斯·杰斐逊（Thomas Jefferson）。留存文献的开场定义是：「The Jefferson cylinder is a deceptively simple device which implements a polyalphabetic substitution cipher; conceived in the late 18th century, it had remarkable cryptographic」，其后接强度评价。同节 (i) 条又写道：「The Jefferson cylinder (Figure 7.3) implements a polyalphabetic substitution cipher while avoiding complex machinery, extensive user computations」。
zh.why: 关键在于它避开了什么：留存文本说该装置实现多表替换，同时避开复杂机械、大量人工计算与列表，因此多表字母表由装置本身承载，而不是由书面表列与人工换算承载。
zh.used: 复算记在 calculations 中：按留存件的实物描述建模——36 个圆盘、每盘周边分为 26 份、各盘以不同的随机次序刻写 26 个字母——把一个 36 字母明文块对齐基准线后，模型给出 26 行读数，基准行复原明文，其余 25 行互不相同且都不同于明文，正对应留存件印出的 "The 25 other parallel reference positions then each define a ciphertext"（该句在本副本被硬回车切成两行）；再以 4598 字母样本切出的 127 个整块，比较装置读法与留存件印出的全维吉尼亚式 ci = ei(mi)（下标 i 对 t 取模，t=36）所得密文，逐字母相同，且逆映射可完整复原 127 块。结构面检查的是：36 个盘两两不同；基准行加其余 25 行给出 26 个互不相同的候选；装置作用为恰好 36 张替换表并随块长重复（4562 个位置与其后第 36 位逐一比对）；由密文回读时，26 行中恰有一行是明文（381 例皆然），这正是留存件 "The other 25 reference positions are examined for a recognizable plaintext"（本副本把 examined 切成 exam- 与 ined 两行）所述做法可用的前提。密钥计数面复现留存件印出的数值：36!约为 3.72 × 10^41；本批次同时计算 25!，但留存件只点名该数而未印其十进制值，这一差别照此写明而非含糊带过。36 个盘的字母次序在本批次由固定种子生成：图 7.3 只印出五个盘行的片段，而非完整次序，因此本文不主张任何历史次序。
zh.broken: 留存文献给出的判定标准是周期：转子机「have an alphabet which changes continuously for a very long period before repeating; this provides protection against Kasiski analysis and methods based on the index of coincidence」。留存文献只把该条件归于转子机，它关于转筒所印的是装置本身与密钥算术：36 个圆盘共轴、每盘周边分 26 份、各盘字母以不同随机次序刻写、以 36 字母块加密、其余 25 个平行基准位置各定义一个密文，并说明改变圆盘次序即改变密钥、圆盘次序共有 36!约 3.72 × 10^41 种；但它没有印出任何完整次序，因此该条目对具体次序不作断言。
zh.history: 构想年份按留存文本记为十八世纪晚期；同一小节把转筒与转子机写在相邻的两句里（两句之间隔着页眉），并称后者是二战期间占主导地位的密码工具。

en.principle: **Person**: Thomas Jefferson. It is registered under polyalphabetic substitution. The entry records only sourced education, employment, publications, standards, machines or events, and verifiable peer assessments; unsourced birth, family, awards and appointments are left blank.
en.why: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in polyalphabetic substitution, not because of its name.
en.used: Fix the object and its aliases; list the sourced dates, roles, parameters or inscriptions; state the observable output; then test the boundary. Any step without a source stops there rather than being filled with prose.
en.broken: The boundary separates a sourced fact, a model-derived relation and an unverified gap. Secondary summaries yield to primary material; unsourced dates, counts and device values stay blank.
en.history: Registered period: Age of Codebreaking. The exact date is left to the ledger; institutional placement and technical detail follow the cited sources.

zh: 杰斐逊转筒：用可转动的筒体承载多个替换字母表的装置。
避免列表与换算：留存文献把该装置与复杂机械、大量人工计算和维吉尼亚列表相对照。
规避条件：留存文献把字母表长时间变化后才重复记为对 Kasiski 分析与重合指数方法的保护。
en: Jefferson cylinder: a device whose rotating cylinders carry the multiple substitution alphabets.
avoiding tables and computation: the source sets the device against complex machinery, extensive user computations and Vigenere tableaus.
protection condition: a very long non-repeating alphabet change is credited with protection against Kasiski analysis and index-of-coincidence methods.

calculations.inputs: a cylinder modelled to the printed description - 36 disks, each periphery divided into 26 parts, each disk carrying the letters in a different random ordering - and one 36-character plaintext block set along the reference bar
calculations.expected: the text says the 25 other parallel reference positions each define a ciphertext: the model must yield exactly 26 rows, the reference row reading back the block and the other 25 being distinct from it and from one another
calculations.limitations: The 36 random orderings are generated from a fixed seed here; the historical arrangement is not printed in the source, so no claim is made about it.

calculations.inputs: the 127 whole 36-letter blocks of the sample read from row 17 of the cylinder, plus a permutation table built by probing the device once per wheel and per alphabet letter
calculations.expected: the handbook states a family of t permutations with the subscript taken modulo t (hac-ch7.txt:1098-1099). Tested against that statement: the permutation acting at position i must equal the one at i + 36 for all 4562 positions checked, the device must present exactly 36 distinct permutations rather than more or fewer, and the row read from the device must equal that family applied with the subscript modulo 36. The equality of position i with position i + 36 holds by construction for this model and is reported as a model property; what is measured is that exactly 36 distinct permutations appear, and the printed sentences are re-read from the registered text.
calculations.limitations: One row offset over one sample. It establishes the period-36 polyalphabetic structure the handbook describes; it is a structural claim, not a security claim, and it does not test the wheel orderings, which are generated here.

calculations.inputs: 36! and 25! computed with exact integer arithmetic
calculations.expected: the handbook prints that reordering the disks changes the key and that the number of possible orderings is 36!, given there as about 3.72 x 10^41, and that re-lettering a disk affords 25! further mappings per disk (hac-ch7.txt:1184-1186); The extract prints the fragments "36!", "3.72" and "1041"; the reconstruction 3.72 x 10^41 must equal 36! rounded, and the fragments themselves are asserted. 25! is computed too, but the handbook names it without printing a decimal value, so no printed figure exists to match and the record says so.
calculations.limitations: These are the source's own counts; they size the key space as printed and say nothing about the security of any particular ordering.

calculations.inputs: the 127 whole blocks enciphered at row offsets 1, 7 and 25, then read back from the ciphertext
calculations.expected: the source prints that the second party holds a cylinder with identically marked and ordered disks, rotates each disk until the ciphertext matches a fixed reference line and examines the other 25 positions for a recognizable plaintext (hac-ch7.txt:1174-1179); the search sentence and the agreed-index sentence are re-read from the registered text; that the plaintext appears exactly once among the 26 rows follows from every wheel being a permutation, so it is reported as a model property that matches the printed instruction rather than as an observation of the source.
calculations.limitations: Round-trips the model at three offsets; it shows the printed description is internally consistent, not how recognizable a real plaintext would be.
